requiredGates.question: Are the source morph, horizontal traverse, archive, editorial index, particle field, geographic plate, and return compositions visibly distinct?
requiredGates.test: Review the complete document at 1440x900 and 390x844; reject a generic repeated split-screen layout.

requiredGates.question: Does the source image become the same semantic terrain rather than cross-fading to unrelated decoration?
requiredGates.test: Scrub the source chapter slowly in both directions and compare texture, geometry, captions, and active copy.

requiredGates.question: Do source end and traverse start share the exact camera position and look-at keyframe?
requiredGates.test: Inspect the trajectory configuration, then cross the boundary slowly, quickly, in reverse, and with repeated direction changes on desktop and mobile.

requiredGates.question: Does vertical scrolling continuously advance the horizontal track and 3D camera through all traverse panels?
requiredGates.test: Measure track translation at the start, quarter, half, three-quarter, and end states; reverse to the exact previous positions.

requiredGates.question: Does the experience remain a readable editorial website rather than a game or isolated 3D viewer?
requiredGates.test: Verify headings, copy, facts, route navigation, locale controls, and captions without requiring pointer manipulation.

requiredGates.question: Are required headings, paragraphs, facts, captions, and controls unobstructed throughout every transition?
requiredGates.test: Inspect at 1440x900, 1280x720, 390x844, and 360x800, including intermediate transition frames.

requiredGates.question: Does mobile use its own camera boundary, reading order, media placement, and type scale?
requiredGates.test: Compare desktop and mobile at the source-to-traverse boundary and at every chapter midpoint.

requiredGates.question: Is all content usable when continuous smoothing and decorative motion are disabled?
requiredGates.test: Enable prefers-reduced-motion, traverse the document with keyboard and touch-equivalent input, and confirm every chapter remains available.

runtime: No console errors, missing assets, background flashes, stale frames, or one-frame camera jumps.
No sustained jank while crossing the source-to-traverse boundary or traversing horizontally.
Only one smooth-scroll owner is active, and native keyboard and touch scrolling remain functional.
Refresh at mid-page and viewport resize preserve the semantic chapter.
Map open and close correctly lock and restore background scrolling and focus.
Asset-loading failure leaves readable editorial content and controls.
